title: Promotion missing from the forecast
brief: UK web orders for SKU B-150 (blender) have been backordered since 5 Nov while other SKUs are fine. Find the root cause and an action plan.

evidence.content: UK web orders for B-150 from 3 to 9 Nov: 2,400 units vs a forecast of 800.
Marketing ran a 30%-off 'Bonfire Week' web promotion on B-150 from 3 Nov. It was not entered in the demand-planning promotion calendar.
B-150 on-hand at Coventry has been 0 since 5 Nov. Safety stock is 250 units, sized for normal weekly variability.
Inbound B-150 flows are on plan; no transport delays.
The supplier is on time. Extra options: 1,500 units by sea in 3 weeks, or 500 units by air in 6 days at +EUR 4/unit.

answer_key.root_cause: An unplanned marketing promotion (not in the demand-planning calendar) tripled B-150 demand, consuming stock and safety stock and causing backorders.

remediation_rubric.criterion: Expedite supply (air 500 + sea 1,500 or similar) and quantify cost
Manage demand: pause/limit the promotion or manage backorders and customer communication
Process fix: promotions must be in the demand calendar / S&OP sign-off
Rebalance stock from other channels or DCs
Review safety-stock policy for promoted items

answer_key.notes: Logistics and supplier are rule-outs; supplier evidence also gives the expedite options.

registry.mechanism_opportunities: Mostly a single-domain (demand) cause; little to forward.
registry.favoritism_notes: Low coordination need; protocol overhead should show up as pure cost.
